svg.text: What happens to a borrower's loan application, step by step · Three actor swim lanes
• Do feature names match schema? → ELSE: POLICY_REJECT
✅ All pass → continue to Step ⑤
❌ Any fail → logged + returned to LSP (no proof)
• Read ONNX file from disk → bytes
Alert sent to lender. No decision issued.
• Build JSON record: app_id · timestamp · model_name
• Append full record (+ shap_values) to JSONL log
• Every 10 decisions: compute binary Merkle tree
Merkle root = SHA-256 tree over all 10 hashes
• Each root is a snapshot of 10 decisions
Continuous tamper-evidence, no manual audit needed
• Proves: approved model H → output O
• Receives proof.json path from EZKL prover
• Attaches proof reference to decision record
• Trust anchor: open math, no cloud vendor
Verifier sees: commitment + prob · Nothing else
• Sent back to LSP → rendered in Borrower UI
• Certificate ID to save for disputes
• Audit log shows new signed record
• Or goes to RBI Ombudsman directly
• No raw data needed from borrower
• Enters cert ID in compliance dashboard
• ZIP package: record + Merkle + ZK proof
Loan disbursed to borrower's account within 30 min
Lender holds cryptographic evidence of decision
Borrower holds Certificate ID for future reference
Borrower gets cert ID + SHAP explanation
Lender protected: signed proof of fair process
Lender notified: model changed without approval
LSP must re-register new model hash to continue
Steps ①–⑱ · Phases 1–10 · Four swim lanes: Borrower · LSP · Sakshi Gateway · Lender
Python 3.11 · Flask · ONNX · EZKL Halo2 · RSA-2048 PSS · SHA-256 Merkle · SHAP LinearExplainer · UCI German Credit
